newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: Portuguese shares calm, only PT is active.
newsitem.headline: Portuguese shares calm, only PT is active.

text.p: 1620 GMT - Shares closed calm with only Portugal Telecom and Banco de Fomento & Exterior seeing much activity. Business likely remain thin on Monday. The U.S. market close will accentuate the usual lull at the start of the week.
*PSI-20 .PSI20 closes 0.12 percent down, while futures also slightly weaker. Cash volume a modest 2.9 billion escudos.
*Portugal Telecom, by far the most active stock with 224,576 shares traded, was reacting to moves in its Wall Street price. There was no other news, traders said.

*Media group Lusomundo gained 60 escudos to 1,100 in active trade of over 100,000 shares after announcing a 232 million escudo first half profit and forecasting a full year profit of 776 million against a 614 million loss in 1995.
